$description: Sunken - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Sunken
line: Under the water: cracked stone tablets with vines, jade and sandstone tiles, wooden knobs, a coral reef and a kelp forest, a whale passing overhead, and a lily pond you can ripple.

voice.searchph: Search the ruins: components, tokens, patterns
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, carved in stone at the bottom of a lagoon.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many worlds. This one is underwater: cracked stone tablets, jade and sandstone tiles, a coral reef, a kelp forest, and a whale passing overhead.
voice.lede.typography: Fredoka sets the titles and labels - round, chunky, like letters cut into game tiles; Nunito carries the reading; the accent is Fraunces italic, like the numbers on a level map.
voice.lede.card: A smooth slab of cut stone with a thick dark edge, kept clear for reading; under the pointer it lifts. The cracked tablets with vines frame the places with little text.
voice.lede.button: A jade tile with a thick edge that presses down; the second action is sandstone. A success sends up a stream of bubbles.
voice.lede.404: Nothing down here but sand. Search, or swim back to the first page.
voice.copyfail: Lost to the current - select the code instead
voice.lede.chip: Chips are sandstone tiles with an engraved word; chosen, the tile turns to jade and sinks in.
